notes: JS monorepo and build-tool caches under $HOME only. No project tree walk, no bulk node_modules scan outside known home cache roots. Deeper residuals beyond batch 03 primary package-manager roots: Rush global folder, Yarn Berry globalFolder side trees, pnpm cacheDir/stateDir/dlx/.tools, Nx home daemon/workspace-data, Turbo daemon, Lerna/Nx-style home caches, Jest/Vitest/SWC/esbuild/Parcel/Biome(rome) under cache dirs, Deno/Bun deeper subtrees, Corepack, Volta/fnm/n/nvs residuals, node-gyp/electron-gyp, Playwright/Cypress residuals, Storybook/Chromatic/size-limit/mochawesome under home caches. Store roots that break hardlinks stay report-only. Apple ~/Library/Biome (OS intelligence) is never targeted.

rules.name: Rush global folder
rules.description: Rush RUSH_GLOBAL_FOLDER default ~/.rush: rush-lib engine installs and shared package-manager bits (not per-repo common/temp).
rules.notes: Regenerable via next rush install/update. Prefer contents of versioned subdirs when present.

rules.name: Yarn Berry globalFolder residuals
rules.description: Yarn 2+ default globalFolder ~/.yarn/berry beyond primary cache (metadata, indexes, mirror-style side data).
rules.notes: enableGlobalCache true stores zip cache under globalFolder/cache. Project .yarn/ is out of scope.

rules.name: pnpm metadata dlx and state side caches
rules.description: pnpm cacheDir (metadata, dlx, verification) and stateDir; not the shared content-addressable store.
rules.notes: macOS cacheDir default ~/Library/Caches/pnpm; stateDir ~/.pnpm-state. Store remains report-only elsewhere.

rules.name: pnpm shared store (report-only)
rules.description: Content-addressable store; deleting breaks hardlinked node_modules until re-fetch.
rules.notes: Prefer pnpm store prune for safe reclaim. Never default-delete.

rules.name: Nx home computation and daemon caches
rules.description: Nx global home cache, workspace-data, and daemon state when NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY / home layout uses ~/.nx (not project .nx).
rules.notes: nx reset equivalent for home-scoped cache. Project-root .nx is not scanned via full-home walk.

rules.name: Turborepo daemon and home task caches
rules.description: Turbo home daemon sockets/logs and task cache trees outside project .turbo.
rules.notes: Project .turbo/cache remains project-local and out of scope.

rules.name: Lerna home / Nx-backed caches
rules.description: Lerna 6+ computation cache via Nx-style home or dedicated lerna cache dirs under known cache roots.
rules.notes: Modern Lerna often shares Nx cache; project node_modules/.cache/nx not walked from home.

rules.name: Changesets tool caches under home
rules.description: Optional @changesets CLI caches when stored under XDG/Library cache roots (not project .changeset).
rules.notes: Project .changeset/ markdown and config must never be targeted.

rules.name: Jest dependency caches under home
rules.description: Jest cacheDirectory when relocated under home cache roots or residual jest dirs under Library/Caches (default is often OS temp).
rules.notes: jest --clearCache. Project-local .cache/jest not walked from home.

rules.name: Vitest caches under home
rules.description: Vitest/Vite-related transform caches when stored under home cache directories.

rules.name: SWC plugin and transform caches
rules.description: SWC experimental cacheRoot and plugin wasm caches under home cache dirs (not project .swc unless under known cache root).

rules.name: esbuild binary and residual caches
rules.description: esbuild downloaded binary/transform caches under XDG and Library residual paths.

rules.name: Parcel caches under home
rules.description: Parcel filesystem caches when relocated under home cache roots (default project .parcel-cache is out of scope).

rules.name: Biome and Rome toolchain caches
rules.description: Biome (Rome fork) daemon logs/caches under ~/.cache/biome; legacy Rome under ~/.cache/rome. Never Apple Library/Biome.
rules.notes: Do not use $HOME/Library/Biome (Apple intelligence streams). Biome CLI defaults logs under ~/.cache/biome/biome-logs.

rules.name: Deno DENO_DIR deeper subtrees
rules.description: Deno module, npm-compat, gen, and deps caches under Library/Caches/deno and ~/.deno residuals.
rules.notes: deno clean. macOS default DENO_DIR often ~/Library/Caches/deno.

rules.name: Bun install cache and global residuals
rules.description: Bun global module cache and install-side residuals under ~/.bun and Library/Caches/Bun.
rules.notes: bun pm cache rm. Do not delete ~/.bun/bin shims by default.

rules.name: Bun global packages (report-only)
rules.description: Globally installed Bun packages under install/global; report size only.

rules.name: Corepack package-manager cache
rules.description: Corepack COREPACK_HOME default ~/.cache/node/corepack (and legacy ~/.node/corepack).
rules.notes: corepack cache clean. Re-downloads yarn/pnpm/npm versions on next use.

rules.name: Volta download cache residuals
rules.description: Volta tool download cache and tmp (not bin shims or pinned tools inventory).
rules.notes: Leave $HOME/.volta/bin and tools installs intact.

rules.name: Volta installed tools (report-only)
rules.description: Volta-managed Node/Yarn/npm tool installs; report only.

rules.name: fnm residual caches
rules.description: fnm residual download/cache trees under home when separate from full node-versions store; multi-shell temp not under home.
rules.notes: Deleting node-versions removes installed Node runtimes. Prefer opt-in.

rules.name: n (tj/n) version cache residual
rules.description: User-prefix n installs when N_PREFIX=$HOME/.n; cache of downloaded Node versions under versions.
rules.notes: Default system /usr/local/n is out of scope. Only user home prefix.

rules.name: nvs Node version residual
rules.description: NVS_HOME default ~/.nvs download/cache trees (not shell integration scripts alone).
rules.notes: Report-only preferred for full ~/.nvs installs; cache subdirs regenerable.

rules.name: node-gyp residual headers caches
rules.description: node-gyp headers/objects residual under home and Library caches.

rules.name: Electron download and electron-gyp deeper caches
rules.description: Electron binary download caches, electron-builder artifacts, and electron-gyp native rebuild headers.

rules.name: Playwright browser download residuals
rules.description: ms-playwright browser binaries and related WebKit/Electron playwright caches under home.
rules.notes: Large browser downloads; re-run playwright install after clean.

rules.name: Cypress binary cache residuals
rules.description: Cypress binary cache default macOS ~/Library/Caches/Cypress and Linux-style ~/.cache/Cypress.
rules.notes: CYPRESS_CACHE_FOLDER override may relocate; only known home defaults listed.

rules.name: Storybook caches under home
rules.description: Storybook manager/builder caches when under home cache roots (not project node_modules/.cache/storybook walk).

rules.name: Chromatic CLI caches
rules.description: Chromatic publish/CLI residual caches under home cache directories.

rules.name: size-limit caches
rules.description: size-limit comparison/build caches under home cache roots.

rules.name: mochawesome residual under home caches
rules.description: Mochawesome report assets/caches only if stored under known home cache roots (not project reports).
rules.notes: Project mochawesome-report/ dirs are out of scope.

rules.name: Puppeteer browser cache residual
rules.description: Puppeteer Chromium download cache under home (companion to Playwright/Cypress).
